==Perihelion (Conjunctions)==
The civil service has identified three conjunctions of the [[Sentinel Gate]] that will allow the heroes of Anvil to travel to places around the Empire to engage the ''scions'' of [[Cold Sun]]. 
===Winds Rising (Bastion)===
* '''The ''scions'' are going to unleash devastation on the gardens of Bastion'''
* '''This skirmish is a [[Accessibility#Combat_Highly_Likely|combat highly likely]] encounter'''
* '''The ''Knight-protector of Spring'' is responsible for defeating the ''scions'''''
When the [[#Winnowers|Winnowers]] [[Things_that_burn#The_Winnowers|first arrived]] in [[Bastion]] they brought with them the famine-wind. While broken by the Gryphon's Pride and the Black Thorns, the ''scions'' have one final weapon to unleash against the Empire. A vortex of foul wind turns on itself within Sybella Cross, gathering power by the hour. It threatens to kill wholesome plants and herbs - especially those that [[herb|help preserve life]] - throughout the territory if it is not stopped. ''Seth of Elmsbreak'', one of the followers of [[Ossegrahn]] who supports the [[Greenwatcher#Implements_of_Willowbraid|Greenwatcher]], has suggested that the soft and gentle rain that is called by [[Regrow the Land's Heart]] could be used to counter the effects of the wind - and to tamp down the threat from the ash that will spread the withering taint across the territory - provided it is invoked before the wind is unleashed.

Casting the ritual at Anvil, using the [[Regio#The_Imperial_Regio|Imperial Regio]], will not be sufficient. By the time the enchantment has settled properly over the territory and begun to work its subtle magic, the famine-wind will have already done its terrible work. Instead, ''Seth'' points to the ''Disordered Expanse'', a Spring regio in the Elms attuned to the resonance of [[Spring_magic#Chaos|chaos]]. The follower of the Cupbearer asks that the [[Knight-protector]] of Spring convince a coven to journey to the regio and perform the ritual. Unfortunately, there are several warbands of ''scions'' still in Bastion and a group of them are near the regio. As soon as the coven begins to perform the ritual, the ''scions'' will realise and move to put a stop to it. Outside the Imperial regio, the ritual takes at least ten minutes to perform, and so it will certainly be necessary to protect the coven performing the ritual.

Under normal circumstances, the [[Greenwatcher]] would be the obvious candidate for responding to Ossegrahn's ally. Unfortunately, there is no Greenwatcher and it's not clear to Seth whether one could be appointed in time to address this opportunity. As a consequence - and in recognition of the Gryphon's Pride's role in defeating the Winnowers in the first place - Seth has requested that the incumbent [[Knight-protector|Knight-protector of Spring]], '''Lord Illantris Wolfborne''', organise a coven to perform [[Regrow the Land's Heart]] and defend them against the ''scions''.

===Doorways (Skarsind)===
* '''A force of ''scions'' are threatening the Storm Pass'''
* '''This skirmish is a [[Accessibility#Combat_Highly_Likely|combat highly likely]] encounter'''
* '''The ''Storm Shaman'' is responsible for defeating the ''scions'''''
Even as the ''grand archon'' of the Still Walkers is defeated, it becomes clear that not all the ''scions'' have been destroyed after all. A small force of ''scions'' has been spotted in [[Skarsind#Pakaanan's_Pass|Pakaanan's Pass]]; they seem to have been making their way west since before the army attacked Westgarden. They have nearly reached their destination, and fortunately their luck seems to have run out. Vigilant [[orc|orcs]] in [[Skarsind#Pakaanan's_Pass|Pakaanan's Pass]] sound the alarm. The scions are climbing toward [[Storm_Shaman#Whitelake_and_the_Storm_Pass|Whitelake]]. The Storm Pass is renowned in the Empire as one of the harshest mountain passes; there is no chance the ''scions'' are braving it without some sinister goal in mind. Orc magicians who have visited the peaks above the Pass believe that Cold Sun might be sending its heralds to channel the [[Day_magic#Force|force]] of the storm in some fashion. The idea of what damage the ''scions'' might be able to do is enough to give the most hardened [[Imperial_Orcs_magical_traditions#Warcasters|warcaster]] pause. This has been a hard winter; even a portion of the terrible wind that funnels down the sides of the mountains and passes over the lake could ruin the Spring harvest, kill lambs and calves, and drown western Skarsind in unseasonal blizzards. 

Given that this is a clear threat to Whitelake and the Storm Pass it is the responsibility of the [[Storm Shaman]], '''Redhand Ikis''', to defeat the ''scions''.

===Hammer Blows (Karov)===
* '''A force of ''scions'' are threatening the Haamrikoht Stone'''
* '''This skirmish is a [[Accessibility#Combat_Highly_Likely|combat highly likely]] encounter'''
* '''The ''Champion of Courage'' is responsible for defeating the ''scions'' and protecting the glade'''
During their time in [[Karov]], the ''scions'' belonging to the [[Eclipse#Blade_of_Skies|Blade of Skies]] have focused their attention on [[Karov#Duzekani|Duzekani]], but they have still made forays into neighbouring regions. Now the army is destroyed, torn apart at the Battle of the Weirwater Gate in Delev. Some of the soldiers of Cold Sun survived and escaped, however, scattering into the woods and hills of southern Karov. One such group has bused the Iron Roads to flee west into [[Karov#Wieliczka|Wieliczka]] - and while they attempt to kill everyone who spots them a band of wardens manages to bring word of their movement to the walled settlement of Vorota. The ''scions'' are not making their way to the town, however. Rather, they are heading into the wooded hills on an older road that ends at the ''Haamrikoht Stone''.

The Haamrikoht Stone marks a glade where, according to history, the exemplar [[Inga Tarn]] and her companions faced and destroyed an [[Plaguewulf#Elder_Plaguewulfs|elder plaguwulf]] - a lieutenant of the Howling Queen who had sought to destroy Vorota. The site serves as a place of pilgrimage for dedicates of [[Courage]], especially those who make a point of visiting the many places commemorating Inga Tarn's heroism around the Empire. The place has no special provenance or magical qualities, but it represents a powerful moment where humans defeated a supernatural force that appeared unassailable. Its loss would be a blow to the spirit of the Empire, and those dedicated to Courage in Varushka in particular. There's also a reasonable possibility that some of those who fled Duzekani to get away from the Blade of Skies may have taken refuge at the relatively isolated spot.

Given that this represents a threat to followers of [[Courage]] it is the responsibility of the [[Champion of Courage]], '''Thomir, Son of Astion''', to defeat the ''scions'', preserve the place of pilgrimage and protect any pilgrims seeking sanctuary there, and prevent the warband of Cold Sun's heralds disappearing into the hills of Wieliczka.
